name: Dorra (Durra) Gas Field Export Pipeline (Saudi share)

values.StartLocation: Dorra (Durra) gas field central gathering platform (offshore Saudi-Kuwait Neutral Zone)

values.RouteNotes: Offshore gas/condensate export line carrying the Saudi share from the Dorra (Durra) field central gathering platform in the Saudi-Kuwait Partitioned Neutral Zone to the Al-Khafji onshore gas processing plant. Part of KJO Dorra development Package 2B (central gathering complex + export pipelines and cables), tender issued and bids submitted (June 2025) but not yet awarded. No published GIS route.

researcher_notes: NEW ROW — all three add-threshold legs met. (a) Sponsor: Al-Khafji Joint Operations (KJO), a JV of Aramco Gulf Operations Company (AGOC, Saudi Aramco) and Kuwait Gulf Oil Company (KGOC, KPC). (b) Endpoints: Dorra (Durra) gas field central gathering platform in the Saudi-Kuwait Partitioned Neutral Zone -> Al-Khafji onshore gas processing plant, Saudi Arabia. (c) Concrete step: EPC tenders for the Dorra offshore packages issued Aug 2024; bids submitted June 2025; Package 1 (7 jackets + intra-field lines) awarded to Larsen & Toubro Energy Hydrocarbon Oct 2025 (~$140-150m). The export line itself is Package 2B (central gathering complex + 'pipelines for gas and condensate transmission to each shareholder' + cables) — tendered and bid, but NOT yet awarded, so status = proposed. Corroboration: >=2 independent outlets (MEED and Times Kuwait, plus NS Energy Business background) — HIGH tier for existence/sponsor/endpoints/status. CAPACITY LEFT BLANK: the 632 mmcf/d figure is contested across sources (some attribute it to the Kuwait-side facility near the Al-Zour refinery, others to the Saudi Khafji plant); field target ~1 bcf/d shared equally implies ~500 mmcf/d Saudi share, but that is an inference — not staged to avoid a wrong value. Length/diameter unknown (no published specs for the offshore export line) — left blank. Route: offshore, no published GIS -> 'no route'; endpoints known so RouteType 'Not mapped (but could be)'. NOT a match to existing rows: P5854 Wafra-Station 171 is an onshore Wafra (different Neutral Zone field) proposed line; P2702 Khafji crude is oil; and separately GGIT P5858 'Khafji Gas Pipeline' is an existing OPERATING 10 km / 40 MMcf/d line from the Khafji OIL field (KPC, Kuwait tab, 2021), a distinct entity from this proposed Dorra export line. Owner entity 'Al-Khafji Joint Operations (KJO)' returns no close existing gas entity (stage as new); AGOC ties to existing 'Aramco' parent.
